changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 7 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields.md`

- names `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — the console object page. The inline branch becomes `ganttViewOptions`, the sibling of `calendarViewOptions` and `timelineViewOptions`: the declared block spread whole, title floored at `'name'`, no date field invented. - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the render branch AND the capability gate. - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `generateViewSchema`, the authored `object-view` element route, which bypasses `ListView` entirely.

### `.changeset/7499-gantt-non-axis-floors-omitted.md`

- names `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the `object-gantt` render branch. - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `generateViewSchema`, the authored `object-view` element route, which bypasses `ListView` entirely.

### `.changeset/7773-kanban-adapter-groupfield-write.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Who is NOT affected — the boundary is node-local.** Every VIEW-LEVEL `groupField` read is untouched and still live: it is a legacy alias of the spec's `groupByField` on the kanban *view config*, mapped by `normalize-list-view.ts`, and both adapters still resolve lanes through it (`ObjectView.tsx`'s `kanbanCfg.groupField ||`, `ListView.tsx`'s `groupByField || groupField`). Authoring `options.kanban.groupField` on a `list-view` or `object-view` keeps working exactly as documented in `packages/plugin-list/README.md`. `groupField` is dead only on the generated `object-kanban` NODE.

### `.changeset/7780-object-kanban-record-source.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **`groupBy` is untouched and stays REQUIRED** (objectui#7322, PR #7774). A record source and a lane key are different questions: every lane-less document above is still refused at `groupBy`, and the two readings PR #7774 excluded from counting as a lane-less mode — the `dataSource` json fragment in `content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx` and `ListView.tsx`'s runtime-generated node — are asserted still-refused in the new pin. The retired `groupField` tombstone is likewise still refused by name.

### `.changeset/8990-object-kanban-groupby-optional.md`

- names `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` **generates** the node as `groupBy: laneField`. `objectDef` loads asynchronously, so `laneField` is `undefined` on every load until it lands, and stays `undefined` whenever the object offers no `stageField` hint and none of `status` / `stage` / `state` / `phase`. The renderer serves that node; both published faces refused it. - `content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx` documents an `object-kanban` node that is exactly `{ type, dataSource }`, with no `groupBy`. ⚠️ This one is weaker and is cited for what it is: that fragment is **still** refused after this change, at `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED`, because `dataSource` is not a rung of the record-source ladder. It shows a lane-less board is a documented authoring; it is not a document this change admits.

### `.changeset/list-user-actions-collision-5398.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The harvest now reads the object block only. Both `userActions` read sites in `ListView.tsx` carry a comment naming the collision, and `__tests__/ListView.userActionsCollision.test.tsx` pins each clause of it: the two shapes, a producer that manufactures the view one, the harvest's blindness to it, and the projection that must keep the object's operand with a toolbar block — or an empty block — present on the view.

### `.changeset/listview-comment-pair-4559.md`

- names `ListView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Two comment corrections in `ListView.tsx` (objectui#4559, objectui#4966). No runtime behaviour changes and the emitted bundle is byte-identical; the published `.d.ts` does change, which is why this is a `patch` rather than an empty frontmatter.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `0651e7ab4` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1334 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1907 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36053521035)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `11962d420111144860bff8b552a68bd852e68641`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (104 of 104 at the review tier). Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Head resolved and diffed.** `GET pulls/10366` gives `head.sha` `11962d420111144860bff8b552a68bd852e68641` on `claude/issue-10275-listview-select-never-omitted`, base `main`; merge-base with `origin/main` is `78b572f60`, the sha the dev's report names. `git diff 78b572f60..11962d420 --stat`: 3 files, +280/-1 — `.changeset/10275-listview-fls-emptied-select.md` (+15), `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (+14/-1), `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.allDeniedSelect-10275.test.tsx` (+251). The `ListView.tsx` hunk is exactly one comment block plus `if (rawCols.length === 0) return undefined;` inserted BEFORE the FLS filter and `if (cols.length === 0) return undefined;` deleted AFTER it. Nothing else in the 5000-line file moves, so every union arm below is the arm that already ran at base for a partially-denied list.
- **(a) Security first — can a denied field reach `$select` on an all-denied list at head?** Walked every arm of `required` in `selectFields`:
  - `id`: `new Set(['id'])`, unconditional. Not FLS-gated, by design and by the triage's own instruction; `PLATFORM_RECORD_COLUMNS` carries it; `ObjectGrid`'s `ensureId` and `RelatedList`'s `new Set(['id'])` do the same.
  - authored columns (`cols`): `rawCols.filter(...)` over `perms.checkField(schema.objectName!, c, 'read')` when `perms.isLoaded && schema.objectName`; on an all-denied list this is empty. Gated.
  - `$expand` roots: the `expandFields` memo gates its OUTPUT — `expandable.filter(...)` over `perms.checkField(schema.objectName!, f, 'read')` when loaded (objectui#7215). A denied lookup column cannot re-enter through `for (const e of expandFields) required.add(e)`. Gated.
  - view bindings (`collectViewFields` over kanban / calendar / gallery / timeline / gantt, both spellings) and the timeline's auto `status` / `priority`: every candidate goes through `addSpeculative`, which returns early when `knownObjectFields.has(f) && !PLATFORM_RECORD_COLUMNS.has(f) && !perms.checkField(schema.objectName, f, 'read')`. Gated for every declared non-platform field (objectui#7216).
  - grid grouping fields: `for (const f of collectGroupingFieldRefs(groupingConfig)) addSpeculative(f)`. Same gate.
  - row-predicate operands: `collectPredicateFieldRefs(listViewPredicates({...}))` into `addPredicateField`, which adds a platform column unconditionally and routes everything else through `addSpeculative`. Gated for every declared non-platform field.
  - **Arms that are NOT FLS-gated, all pre-existing:** (1) `id`; (2) the platform record columns (`created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`, `organization_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`) through a view binding or a predicate operand — the carve-out `addSpeculative`'s comment and the 7216 changeset document (no object declares them, so `checkField` answers false for all of them); the dev's report and the head comment both name this exception; `RelatedList` and `ObjectGrid` (`passesProjectionGate` returns true for an undeclared name) admit them the same way; (3) when `objectDef?.fields` is absent (`knownObjectFields === null`), `addSpeculative` skips BOTH gates — reachable, because the loader's `finally { setObjectDefLoaded(true) }` fires when `getObjectSchema` throws or returns null; the builder's own comment calls this "virtually never hit". All three arms ran identically at base for any partially-denied list. **This PR introduces no new ungated arm**; it only routes the all-denied case into the existing union. On every path, head requests a subset of what base requested (base requested the whole record on that path), so the change is strictly narrowing.
- **(b) The declared widening vs the triage rule.** Triage (`5818583773`): "全部被拒时请求 `['id']` 加上行谓词需要的字段,⛔ 永不省略 `$select`" and the test wording "`$select` 存在且只含 `id`(及谓词字段)". Head keeps FLS-gated view bindings, grouping fields and `$expand` roots as well. The intent — never omit `$select`, never request a denied field — is met on every arm above. The letter differs only when a readable per-row field is bound (a kanban lane, a calendar date, a grouped column); such a field is requested today by the partially-denied path and by both siblings: `ObjectGrid` composes `withHarvestedFields(ensureId(...))` (predicate AND grouping fields on top of `id`), and `RelatedList` (objectui#10258) adds `$expand` roots, predicate operands and the gallery cover field on top of `id`. Keeping them is what the triage's "与 `ObjectGrid` / `RelatedList` 对齐" actually asks for; dropping them would blank a kanban lane on an all-denied list without protecting any denied value. Judged a difference in letter, not in what matters; the readable-kept / denied-dropped pair is pinned (case 3).
- **(c) Controls unchanged, read at base vs head.** No authored columns: base `rawCols=[]` ⇒ `cols=[]` ⇒ `undefined`; head `rawCols.length === 0` ⇒ `undefined`. Policy not loaded: both `cols = rawCols`, union runs. Partially denied: both project `['id', 'subject']`. The diff touches no other line, so the three paths are byte-identical in effect.
- **(d) Pins real and able to fail; ablation consistent.** Seven `it` cases; `paramsFor` reads `dataSource.find.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[1]` and asserts on the `$select` key by `hasOwnProperty`. Under the ablation (survivor test restored) I derive: case 1 (`['id']`) RED — `$select` absent; case 2 (`['id','region','status']`, `priority` denied and absent) RED; case 3 (readable kanban binding kept / denied dropped) RED — spreading an absent `$select` throws before the assertion; case 7 (late policy re-projects to `['id']`) RED; cases 4 (partial), 5 (absent and `[]` columns), 6 (policy not loaded ⇒ `['id','industry','salary']`) GREEN under both trees. 4 RED / 3 GREEN, as reported. The `usePermissions` stub mocks the module `ListView.tsx` imports (`import { usePermissions } from '@object-ui/permissions'`), swaps by identity, and `checkField` answers from `READABLE = ['id','subject','status','region']`, so `salary`, `industry`, `priority` are denied. Case 2's operands come from `objectDef.actions[0].visible` / `disabled` (read by `listViewPredicates` as `objectActions`) and from `conditionalFormatting[0].condition`; the harvest reads both at head. Not re-run locally.
- **(e) Changeset sentences vs code.** Frontmatter `'@object-ui/plugin-list': patch` — the package name matches `packages/plugin-list/package.json` and it is in the single `fixed` group.
